title: Fieldset docs site versions.json, schema 1
description: Served at /fieldset/versions.json and rewritten by every docs publish (ADR 0094, docs site plan U5). Schema 1 is frozen and additive only: readers ignore unknown fields and fall back to their baked values for a schema above 1 (docs/site/lib/versions-reader.mjs). Rules the keywords below cannot state: minors are unique, each copy's minor is the major.minor of its version, tag is v plus version, prerelease is true exactly when version has a pre-release part, latest names one of the copies (the newest final, or the newest pre-release while no final exists), and copies are listed newest first. The writer publishes only finals and rc.N pre-releases from 2.1 on; readers accept any release version.

schema.description: Contract version; 1 until an incompatible change, which readers of schema 1 then ignore.

latest.description: The minor that /fieldset/latest/ and the home page's docs links open.

copies.description: One entry per published minor, newest first.

minor.description: A minor version; the only value readers put into a URL (/fieldset/<minor>/).

version.description: A release version in the grammar of ReleaseVersion::PATTERN (app/Domain/Instance/Release/ReleaseVersion.php).

tag.description: The release's git tag: v plus the version.

version.description: The release this copy was built from.

prerelease.description: True for a copy built from a pre-release, which shows the pre-release notice.

builtWith.description: Full SHA of the main commit whose docs/site tooling built the copy.
